title: Intrinsically Nonflammable Ionic Liquid-Based Localized Highly Concentrated Electrolytes Enable High-Performance Li-Metal Batteries

notes: Text source is captions plus linked text only; all supporting-information results (LSV, wettability, transference number, in-situ optical microscopy, FTIR) are named in the linked text but have no figure in the packet and were left out of the graph. Lost detail: the Li/Cu polarization ladder (F2b), the MD coordination snapshots (F1f), the mechanism schematics (F4d-f) and the limited-Li LFP/Li@Cu cell (F5c-e) are described in the packet but not typed as nodes. Two causes edges enter e3 (inorganic SEI and ionic conductivity), both joint per Figure 4d-f. Four audits record figure-text tensions: commercial conductivity highest in F1a, ILE efficiency running to ~600 cycles in F2a, Li2O resolved only for LHCE in F4b, and the commercial 5 C cell matching LHCE to ~400 cycles in F5b. Judge: o16 was split so that the printed 87% retention and the right-axis Coulombic-efficiency trace are separate readings of F5b; the 'low polarization' clause was dropped from v4 because F2b is not typed as a node.

changes: o16 split into o16 (the 87% retention printed on F5b) and new OBS node o17 (the right-axis Coulombic-efficiency trace of the same panel); new edge o17 -> g2 evidences with mm_op read_characteristic_point. The two readings need different read_from values.

v4 label trimmed from 'about 99.4% Coulombic efficiency with low polarization' to the efficiency claim alone. The polarization claim is a second property, it has no OBS node (F2b is not typed and shows the LHCE alone), and splitting it out would have pushed the spine past 20; it is recorded in v4 attrs.image_note.
v2 source inferred -> text: the 3.2 and 1.1 mS cm-1 values, and with them the 'about three times' comparison, are text numbers, and F1a reads about 0.7 and about 3.4 (o2).
requires_unseen filled on v3, v4 and g1 for the caption/text facts their labels carry (carbonate comparator and the 'intrinsic' attribution; Li/Cu cell; Li/Li symmetric cell).

No merges: every OBS/claim pair here is a readout and the claim it evidences (o1/v1, o2/v2, o3/v3, o8/v4, o11/e3, o12-o13/e2, o15/g3, o16/g2), and a3 (Li2O only in the LHCE trace) is the text-silent tension, not a duplicate of o13.

Not split, with reason: h1 is one need stated with its two requirements, h2 one hypothesis whose two consequences are the chain v1 -> v2, e3 and o11 one comparative morphology claim stated against its two controls, o7 one partition reading (that is what component_partition is), and o10 one stability reading of F2c with its two insets.
No spine, type, rel or mm_op changes. The graph was v04-valid before and after.

pairs.cause: Dissolution of LiFSI in [PP13][FSI] followed by HFE at 1:2
pairs.effect: Localized Li+-FSI- solvation structure and a dense inorganic SEI rich in LiF, Li2O and S=O
pairs.note: the graph splits the record's single effect in two and puts the plating act between them: p1 -> e1 produces the solvation structure, and the SEI is produced by the plating step p2 and caused by e1 (e1 -> e2), explained by m1 (LUMO on FSI-).

pairs.cause: Localized Li+-FSI- solvation structure and the inorganic SEI
pairs.effect: ionic conductivity, Coulombic efficiency, viscosity, Li+ transference number
pairs.note: the efficiency half runs e2 -> m2 -> e3 -> v4. Viscosity and conductivity hang off the processing act (p1 -> v1 -> v2), not off the solvation structure, which is how the paper argues them; the transference number is a Supporting-Information result with no panel and is not in the graph. Two figure-text tensions are recorded as audits: a1 (the commercial electrolyte holds the highest conductivity in F1a, so 'nearly triple the ILE' is not 'best') and a2 (the ILE efficiency trace runs to about 600 cycles in F2a against the text's 250).

pairs.cause: ionic conductivity, Coulombic efficiency, viscosity, Li+ transference number
pairs.effect: dendrite-free Li over 800 cycles, 5000 cycles in Li/Li at 10 mA cm-2, 87% retention after 1000 cycles at 5 C
pairs.note: v4 -> g1 causes, g1 -> g2 supports, v4 -> g3 supports, and v2 -> e3 causes carries the conductivity route. The graph places dendrite-free deposition upstream as a structure claim (e3) rather than as an effect of the properties, and a4 bounds g2 (the commercial cell matches the LHCE for the first about 400 cycles at 5 C).
